erroneous_json.name: fastjson-parser
erroneous_json.description: A fast JSON parsing library written in C.
erroneous_json.makefile:
CC=gcc
CFLAGS=-Wall -O2
SRC=parser.c utils.c
all: libfastjson.a

libfastjson.a: $(SRC)
	ar rcs $@ $^

clean:
	rm -f *.o libfastjson.a

description:
I’m excited to announce the release of **fastjson-parser** v 1.3.0, a fast JSON parsing library written in C. The source distribution consists of three files—`parser.c`, `utils.c`, and the header `fastjson.h`—and it depends on the **cjson** package (≥ 2.0.0). For development and testing we use **cmocka** (≥ 1.1.0). The project lives at the GitHub repository `user/fastjson-parser`, and it is released under the MIT license. In a nutshell, the library is aimed at developers needing a lightweight and speedy JSON parser; relevant keywords include **json**, **parser**, **c**, and **fast**.

Below is the makefile used to build the static library, followed by the standard install and uninstall commands:  

```
CC=gcc
CFLAGS=-Wall -O2
SRC=parser.c utils.c
all: libfastjson.a

libfastjson.a: $(SRC)
	ar rcs $@ $^

clean:
	rm -f *.o libfastjson.a
```

To install the library system‑wide run `make install PREFIX=/usr/local`, and to remove it use `make uninstall PREFIX=/usr/local`.
